meta.name: info-funnel
meta.description: 3-6 阶递减漏斗, 突出转化率 / 筛选比例 / 流量损耗。竖图适合 IG Story / 小红书

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作转化漏斗图，突出流量损耗与筛选比例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在社交媒体上展示营销漏斗数据
copy.tagline_en: Create conversion funnel charts highlighting traffic loss and filter ratios
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to present marketing funnel data on social media

howto.what: 你给它 3-6 个有序阶段和每阶段数值（人数 / 件数 / 金额），它产出一张 9:16 竖屏的单文件 HTML 漏斗图：每段左侧大数字、右侧阶段名，段间标阶段转化率，底部放累计转化率和 1-2 句漏出洞察。
howto.when: 当你要把一段从大到小的转化、筛选或损耗过程画成图时接管，比如营销漏斗、招聘漏斗、决策漏斗；默认输出 1080×1920 竖图，适合 IG Story / 小红书。

say.text: 把访客→注册→试用→付费→留存 5 阶数据做成漏斗图
say.note: 输出 9:16 竖屏单文件 HTML

say.text: 换成招聘漏斗：投递→面试→录用→入职
改用 sunset-amber 主题，底部写最大漏出环节

howto.what_en: Give it 3-6 ordered stages with counts per stage. It outputs a 9:16 vertical single-file HTML funnel: big number left, stage name right, per-stage conversion rate between segments, and a bottom strip with cumulative rate plus 1-2 insight lines.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you want a large-to-small conversion, filtering or drop-off process turned into one image, such as marketing, hiring or decision funnels. Default output is a 1080×1920 vertical image.

say_en.text: Turn visitors → signups → trials → paid → retained into a funnel chart
Redo it as a hiring funnel: apply → interview → offer → onboard
Switch to the sunset-amber theme and note the biggest drop-off
